data.title: On-chan no Kyou wa Donna Kanji?
data.title_japanese: onちゃんのきょうはどんなかんじ？
data.synopsis:
On-chan no Kyou wa Donna Kanji? selects kanji related to Hokkaido that are compulsory for elementary school students in the lower grades, and aims to help with local education. On-chan, a popular mascot character of Hokkaido Television Broadcasting (HTB) that is loved by all generations, takes a single kanji character as a theme and freely imagines its meaning and shape, and performs a cute dance according to the stroke order.

(Source: Taiyo Kikaku, translated)

data.title: Sseulegiui Seom
data.synopsis:
After 50 years of floating in the ocean, plastic rubbishes formed a huge garbage patch. The background of <The Isle of Trashes> is set in the "Great Pacific Garbage Patch". On the Trash Island, various characters stumble across each other regardless of their will. They each face a tragic ending in this hopeless island.

(Source: Yeoleum)

data.title: Yuuyake
data.synopsis:
As usual, the train was packed. The girl sitting in her seat gives her seat to an old man. But then another one came. By portraying the sufferers in the midst of the mundane, the film asks the question of "suffering" and what kindness is in the modern age. This work is an animation of the world of a song sung by Wataru Takada based on a poem by Hiroshi Yoshino.

(Source: Official website)
